prompt: Turn this movie idea into a full 8,000–10,000-word story about the Ghostbusters reuniting to battle a river of psychomagnetic slime under Manhattan and an evil 17th-century tyrant trapped in a painting. Start with Dana Barrett’s frantic buggy chase and build up to the courtroom clash, a creepy haunted birthday party, and the climactic rescue of her baby, ending with the team calling on the Statue of Liberty to save New York. Make sure your narrative balances sharp humor with supernatural thrills, deepens the bonds between the four Ghostbusters and Dana, and weaves in an unexpected twist around ancient prophecy. Keep the pacing brisk, the banter snappy, and let the city itself feel like another character in your thrilling ghost story.
